div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ATECC608A 槽位策略
Slot 0: ECDSA P-256 私钥
Never-Read，仅允许 Sign
Config Lock + Data Lock

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
I2C 命令时序
Wakeup -> 命令帧
Length / OpCode / Param / Data / CRC16
等待执行 -> 读响应 -> Sleep

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 数据帧构造
SensorTask 采集并组装 JSON

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 摘要计算
规范化序列化
HASH-SHA256

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 芯片签名
Wakeup -> Sign 指令 0x41
等待 tEXEC
取回 64B 签名值 r,s

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 DER 编码
原始 r,s
转 ASN.1 DER

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 上传
signature_envelope
经 HTTPS 发送

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 性能备注：ATECC608A 签名实测约 7 ms；从采集到封装上传整个路径约 15~25 ms。
